topology: Add C_eff once after the multiplier emits its unchanged prepack P_hat; no stream reordering and no intermediate product pack/saturation
prepack_value: (-1)^sign * magnitude * 2^(scale-fractional_bits); q=FRAC_W; finite normalized-product magnitude in [2^q,2^(q+2))
window_layout: W total signed retained bits; Q=W-3 fraction bits, two magnitude integer bits and one sign bit. Residual sign/nonzero and other metadata are additional wires/registers, outside W.
alignment: Scale each magnitude to 2^(anchor-Q); floor each magnitude only once. Largest operand fits exactly. At most the smaller operand has a discarded dyadic residual.
residual: Track sign and nonzero of the single discarded operand. Add/subtract retained magnitudes. If residual opposes nonzero retained sum, decrement abs(retained sum) by one grid unit and retain positive tail. This is borrow conversion of Z-delta to (Z-1)+(1-delta), not an unconditional jam or a per-term correction.
zero_tail: retained_sum=0 with residual_nonzero is forbidden by the admitted precision bound; assert/fail if observed, never silently output zero. Exact cancellation has no residual.
precision_bound: Admit only Q>=max(F,FRAC_W+1)+3. A cut implies delta_sf>=4; opposite-sign loss can normalize left by at most one bit. At least two retained bits below the largest output fraction remain. Main profile admits all four windows; exact-product requests are rejected.
flags: NaR priority flags=10000; sat_max/min only from final fused sum; inexact is input/term/iteration metadata OR numerical final loss; approx_cut only omitted multiplier iterations. Zero preserves prior finite loss metadata. No product saturation flags inherited from NF.
state: C_eff=c in standalone; acc_clr selects zero on accepted acc_mode transaction; otherwise C_eff=own F accumulator. Commit rounded F output once; reset clears it and cancels pending. NF and F maintain separate states for paired sequences.
selection_before_run: Select the smallest admitted W with zero bits/flags/slice/tail mismatches against full-grid reference on the fixed >=100000 pilot per W, and the precision bound satisfied. Otherwise leave selection open and report counterexamples; do not change seeds or thresholds.

acceptance.near_definition: finite nonzero P_hat and C_eff, opposite signs, abs(delta_sf)<=4; count before and after alignment

corpus.standalone_or_acc: acc_mode iff serial%4==3; acc_clr iff acc_mode and serial%97==3
corpus.classes: serial%20: zero A=0, NaR A=1, NaR C=2, C=0 at3, zero B=4, cancellation/adjacent opposite packed P at5..16, unbiased raw otherwise; corners and synthetic boundary cases are additional

limits: This is fused RNE of approximate P_hat, not exact A*B+C
